title: Effect card template

fields.instruction: What is it? What does it do? How large or consequential is its actual impact? Name the gameplay state the player must understand.

Record separate caster, ally and enemy ratings on the project’s chosen scale. Riot documents 1–10; no universal mapping to size, value, duration or count is established. Record why this cue outranks its neighbors.
Name the event and intended feeling. Distinguish information that must be perceived from optional embellishment.
Event source, position, direction, area/hitbox, activation and expiry, targetability, cancellation and prediction/reconciliation behavior. Decorative shape cannot silently change any of these.
Caster, ally, enemy, spectator, distance, camera angle, occlusion rules and privacy of information. State which secondary layers each audience can omit.
Asset IDs and rights; flipbook grid, frame count, resolution per cell, intended rate, loop/one-shot mode, premultiplication/edge assumptions, and whether random start preserves meaning.
Identify the single dominant shape, focal point, direction, source and target. Record small-screen and grayscale checks.
Dominant palette, accent, core/edge relationship, stage backgrounds, team/rarity/status redundancy. Use project measurements; no universal ratios established.

List primary, secondary and tertiary layers with each layer’s communication purpose, emitter/beam/trail/part/light type, orientation, attachment, and stop condition. Remove roles duplicated without benefit.

Windup, punch, crescendo, follow-through and dissipation. Store durations in seconds or ms with their source and context; if frames, store the relevant fps/timebase. Unsupported values remain unset, not zero.
Start/end size, life curves, speed, acceleration, arcs, overlap, squash/stretch, rotation, inherited motion and world/camera alignment. State how they affect the intended feeling.

Named sound event, visual sync landmark, trigger timestamp, intended relative offset, source-supported tolerance if available, and measured latency on target device. Keep network arrival separate from asset timing.
Shake/kick/zoom/flash/blur/slow motion: scope, affected player, optionality, accessibility controls and restoration behavior. Omit if it impairs the required task.
Allowed variants, semantic invariants, aggregation/cooldown/cap policy, combo escalation rule and reset condition. No count, delay or step size is a universal default.
Worst-case simultaneous events, competing critical cues, stage palette, overlap footprint and resolution when cues conflict.
Full recorded-sequence flash testing method/result; reduced motion/flash effects; colour alternatives; preserved gameplay information. No numeric pass is treated as a medical guarantee.

Target devices/graphics levels; observed frame time and frame-time spikes; transparent coverage; active/emitted particles; texture residency; lights; instancing/pool cleanup. Hardware and measurement method are required.
Describe what remains at each project quality tier. Preserve truth, timing and threat boundaries before retaining sparks, smoke, bloom or light.
Moment; symptom; evidence/capture; concrete parameter or phase change; expected result; priority; retest outcome. Change a stated cause, not merely “more polish.”
Source IDs and claim IDs; evidence level per claim; inferred values and test results; unresolved gaps; owner/version/date; pass/fail against the required checks.

intro: Start here before selecting assets or reviewing a finished effect. The card records facts, choices and evidence separately so a later designer can explain each change.
